plugin.name: RehearsalPlayer
plugin.title: Rehearsal Player
plugin.desc: Dark, playlist-driven rehearsal playback with tutor/class filters, artwork playlist selection, large transport controls, quick jump presets, and a Spotify-backed teacher playlist section.
plugin.changes: Added a built-in on-screen keyboard to the Spotify search popup, since the kiosk is a touchscreen with no attached physical keyboard. The search field now suppresses the device's own software keyboard (inputmode="none") so this one is the only keyboard that shows up - QWERTY layout with shift, backspace, a 123/ABC toggle for numbers and punctuation, and a Done key.
plugin.creator: Jazzart
